entities.summary: Ottoman, a notable figure in the history of Saudi Arabia, associated with Mamluk and Early Ottoman Arabia (1517–1600). Preceded by Ottoman Conquest and Hejaz Province and Ottoman Sultan Selim I accepted as Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques. Their legacy influenced Ibn Saud-Wahhab Pact.
